image_sources: https://github.com/drippinghere/overwatch-hero-icons (3d/ folder, 256x256 RGBA; README: all 53 heroes as of Season 4: Heroes of Busan)
notes: 54 playable heroes (15 Tank / 23 Damage / 16 Support) as of Season 5 2026 'A Grim Doctrine' (launched Oct 6, 2026). Sub-roles are official. Season 5: Doctrine added (Support/Survivor); Sombra reworked from Damage/Recon to Support/Tactician (Hack and Virus removed, new Hotfix heal and Weaken status); Roadhog reworked (Trash Compactor replaces secondary fire, hook combo toned down). Forward-pick changes for Season 5: calico Sombra->Reaper, haze Sombra->Soldier: 76 (Sombra is no longer a pick-off damage hero). Earlier forward-pick changes: mokrill Winston->Venture, shiv Reaper->Vendetta, venator Freja->Ashe. Six new Deadlock heroes (build 6805) added Oct 21, 2026.
